title: Unify editor capture producer timeline with the CTest state-trail contract
body: The editor capture test expected parameter edits at frames 20-23, toggle/undo/redo, save/reopen/settings/back, and captures at 5,25,45,75,105,115, but VIXEN/temp/run_editor_script.bat contained only toggle/undo/redo and captures at 5,45,75,105. This lane had to hand-synchronize the batch producer with the test's hard-coded timeline before the native EditorToggleUndoCapture suite passed. Generate the producer script and capture frame list from one authoritative test contract.
